borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Construction of a part two storey part single storey extension to facilitate a community hall and 1no. first floor 2x bed flat
decision_conditions: The proposal would be of a poor quality design, located within a landlocked site, intensifying a poor quality access route, requiring pedestrian visitors to merge with vehicles, and failing to accommodate suitable access for all users. The residential component would lack street frontage and would fail to represent an overall good quality of development, failing to positively contribute to the area, contrary to:- The National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December, 2024)- Policies D1, D4,  and D5 of the London Plan (March 2021)- Policies DMD1, DME2,  and SP5 of the London Borough of Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September, 2024)

The addition of the residential unit at the first floor level by reason of scale, siting and design would result in significantly impacting adjoining sites and neighbouring dwellings which would result in creating a sense of overbearing, loss of outlook, over looking and an increase in coming and goings, noise, activity and potential disturbances to the site and adjoining access route. This will result in causing undue harm to adjoining and surrounding residents, as such, therefore constituting unneighbourly development and contrary to:- National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September, 2024)

The submission fails to provide sufficient information with respect to the provision and management of cycle parking and refuse storage and collection. The proposal is likely to result in a detrimental impact on the site and surrounding area with inadequate and/or unsafe refuse storage arrangements, and insufficient space for cycle parking. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following:- The National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policies DMT 3, SP8,  DMS1, and DMSI 8 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)
